primaryRoute.title: __MISSING__:Primary API Route
primaryRoute.description: __MISSING__:Choose which canonical host your primary API requests go to. The Venice route is the default and supports the full endpoint surface. The Fraterna route mirrors a curated subset (/models, /chat/completions, /image/generate, /images/generations); every other endpoint automatically falls back to the Venice host. Fraterna is a third-party service separate from Venice Forge and Venice.ai — its proxy records selected request metadata for successful proxied requests per its public documentation.
primaryRoute.label: __MISSING__:Primary API Route

venice.label: __MISSING__:Venice (default)
venice.description: __MISSING__:Canonical Venice API host. Required for billing, audio, video, characters, API-key administration, x402, crypto RPC, augment, embeddings, image edit/upscale/multi-edit, and every other endpoint not documented for Fraterna.

fraterna.label: __MISSING__:Fraterna
fraterna.description: __MISSING__:Public Fraterna upstream that mirrors a curated subset of the Venice API contract (/models, /chat/completions, /image/generate, /images/generations). All other endpoints fall back to the Venice host automatically. Fraterna is a third-party service separate from Venice Forge and Venice.ai; it reuses the Venice API key but records selected request metadata for successful proxied requests per its public documentation.

primaryRoute.webDisabled: __MISSING__:The Primary API Route is configured per-profile in the desktop app. In web mode, the route is set by the VENICE_FORGE_PRIMARY_API_ROUTE server environment variable (default: Venice).

responsesApi.title: API Responses (Alpha)
responsesApi.description: Utilisez l'API Responses alpha de Venice (POST /responses) comme transport de chat pour les nouveaux messages.
